title: Reflex Classifier (Qwen3-0.6B Q8_0, GGUF-native cold-start inference)
description: Zero-shot classification and intent routing on scale-to-zero GPU endpoints, backed by Reflex: a GGUF-native engine that compiles its CUDA kernels ahead of time (no runtime JIT), so a cold worker reaches its first result fast. POST /v1/classify scores every label as a continuation of the prompt in one prefill and returns each label's probability within the set plus the entropy -- nothing is generated, so a decision is one forward pass, not a decode loop. Also serves OpenAI-compatible chat completions, streaming or not. On Runpod, cold Reflex was ~42-44s vs the official vLLM worker's ~150s (same GPU tier/day; vLLM also pulled bf16 weights; endpoint types differed) -- most of both is platform provisioning; Reflex's own engine load was ~1.6s. Qwen3-0.6B Q8_0 baked in. batch_size is always 1 -- steady high-QPS chat wants vLLM. Guide: https://github.com/lateos-ai/reflex/blob/master/docs/deploy-serverless.md

input.name: Adapter Arguments
input.description: Extra reflex-openai-adapter flags, space-separated, e.g. "--max-tokens-cap 1024 --default-max-tokens 128". Request limits default to max_tokens 2048, prompt 256 KiB, queue depth 16, timeout 300 s.
